content.about: Guinea-Bissau is a small country on West Africa's coast, with mangroves and the Bijagós islands. Its islands have unique cultures and wildlife. Cashew nuts are its main export. Portuguese is the official language.

standout.text: The Bijagós Archipelago is home to saltwater hippos.

didYouKnow: Bijagós hippos swim in the sea.
It has many sea turtle nesting beaches.
